title: Plate Spinning
tagline: Whip each plate in time before it wobbles and falls.
description: Keep porcelain, lacquer, jade and gold plates spinning on bamboo poles on a theatre stage inspired by Chinese acrobatics. Whip each one inside its sweet band, build combos, survive acts that add a pole each time. Practice, Watch and Learn and an exhaustive Rules page included.
howToPlay: Every plate slowly loses spin and starts to wobble.
Tap a plate or its pole to whip it back to full speed.
Whip while the needle is in the gold zone for a Perfect.
Whipping a fast plate too soon makes it jolt and breaks your combo.
Jade plates need two quick taps in a row.
Three broken plates end the show; each act adds a pole.
Think slows time for a moment and rings the plate that needs you most.
Keyboard: 1 to 8 whip the poles left to right, H is Think, Space pauses.
